thread:
jordan_cs: Heads-up 10:20 UTC4 — VelvetHealth saw repeated 502s and stream disconnects from APAC during a product demo. They asked if we can route demo traffic to an APAC edge and give a short-lived rate uplift to cover demo spikes. Renewal check in ~16 days; they said demo quality will influence renewal.

kai_se: What traffic shape and endpoints?

jordan_cs: Mostly /v1/chat and streaming. Customer logs show ~140 rps sustained for 7m with bursts to ~360rps. They
 like ap-southeast-1-edge + a 2x QPS uplift for 12h starting ASAP.

anya_netops: We can enable ap-southeast-1-edge quickly and add their IP ranges to the allowlist. Need CIDRs and exact start/end times. Recommend ACL with auto-revoke at +12h to avoid stale rules.

jordan_cs: CIDRs provided: 103.21.244.0/22, 45.76.192.128/26. Requested window: start 12:00 UTC today -> end 00:00 UTC (+12h).

anya_netops: Creating ACL entry "velvet-demo-5567" -> acl-20011. Will apply to ap-southeast-1-edge and schedule revoke at +12h.

kai_se: For safety, set a per-route QPS override on their token route instead of changing global account quotas. I'll push route override x2 and pin traffic to the APAC burst pool. Also enable request-level retries=1 for demo traffic.

felix_infra: I can spin up a small burst node group in ap-southeast-1 (2 x A10g equiv) and tag velvet-burst-5567. I'll open INC-4822 and tag eng-sre for monitoring.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4822 "VelvetHealth APAC demo: edge allowlist + temp qps override" by felix_infra. ETA: 45m.

jordan_cs: Please add renewal note: customer explicitly said performance will affect renewal. Set renewal_risk: medium-high.

anya_netops: ACL applied to ap-southeast-1-edge, rule id acl-20011. Please confirm customer test ready.

jordan_cs: Sent curl sample and scheduled smoke at 12:05 UTC. curl they received:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VELVET_DEMO"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gptx-apac","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"smoke test"}]}'
```

kai_se: I'll monitor traces, percentage of streamed token latencies, and error rates for the route. If 5xxs persist we will fallback to hosted-apac-replica and dial the QPS down.

felix_infra: Burst nodes provisioned, route override pushed, auto-revoke set at +12h. Closing loop after verification. :white_check_mark:

jordan_cs: Thanks team 1:05 UTC4 — demo completed, collecting customer feedback now and will update renewal tracker + playbook.
